title: Đội cứu hộ — Tổng quan
prompt: Design the volunteer/rescue-team dashboard in Vietnamese responsive web: assigned mission offers, active missions, team readiness/availability, recent notices and quick next action. Respect scoped membership and leader-only controls. Use calm operational shell from source, suitable for browser on laptop and phone; no separate native mobile app framing. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

title: Đội cứu hộ — Chi tiết nhiệm vụ
prompt: Design mission list and selected mission detail for an assigned rescue team: location, request facts allowed to team, status timeline, leader accept/decline with reason and deadline, team contact, evidence. No public victim details and no coordinator priority edits. Vietnamese responsive web, operational shell. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

title: Đội cứu hộ — Cập nhật tiến độ
prompt: Design an active mission progress form and history page: permitted mission state transitions, observation notes, optional evidence upload, result summary, completion confirmation, retry/error states. Clearly distinguish draft from server-confirmed update. Vietnamese responsive web and same operational shell. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

title: Đội cứu hộ — Hồ sơ và vị trí đội
prompt: Design team profile management in Vietnamese: members, leader, skills/capabilities, capacity, availability, last reported position with captured time and accuracy, update position action and permission explanation. Show only controls authorized by actual team role. Responsive web, same operational shell. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.
